target_definition: First published reported quarterly PAT attributable to owners, including any eventual exceptional items. No new exceptional item is assumed in these forecasts.
normalization_basis: No exceptional item in the four selected quarters. The prior 9M exceptional expense 25.911 cr belongs to an earlier quarter and is not a December addback. The issuer describes December 2025 labour-code impact as immaterial without a separate amount. Ongoing remediation and peptide losses are retained as operating economics.

model_formula: (revenue_cr * ebit_margin + other_income_cr - finance_cost_cr + exceptional_pretax_cr) * (1 - tax_rate) + associates_after_tax_cr - nci_cr
margin_definition: EBIT excluding other income and finance costs, after depreciation and amortisation. This is not EBITDA margin.
rationale: Assume continuing finished-dosage and complex-generics throughput supports modest revenue growth, but persistent input/logistics pressure and peptide losses limit the profit increase. The base allows financing benefit from the stronger cash position while preserving meaningful financing costs. It is deliberately below the seasonal additive and YoY-ratio forecasts because those do not encode current margin pressure.

parameter_assumptions.revenue: 1625 cr, 4.2% above Q2, lower than the prior-year Q2-to-Q3 revenue increase of 7.0%. No unapproved first-to-file launch windfall is included.
parameter_assumptions.ebit_margin: 15.75% versus Q2 approximately 16.26% and Q1 approximately 17.56%. It embeds continuing peptide losses and input-cost pass-through lag. No separate addback of peptide losses.
parameter_assumptions.other_income: 10 cr near Q2. Warrant proceeds support liquidity, not operating revenue.
parameter_assumptions.finance_cost: 18 cr versus Q2 20.974 cr, allowing modest debt-cost benefit. Net cash does not eliminate gross borrowings or leases.
parameter_assumptions.nci_cr: Zero, confirmed in official NSE owner/NCI rows for current and prior periods.

adverse.assumptions: Input/logistics pressure, weaker product mix and regulatory remediation constrain shipments. Revenue 1500 cr and EBIT margin 14%. Peptide losses can remain near historical stressed levels.

base.assumptions: Modest volume/mix growth with cost recovery lag and continuing peptide losses. Lower financing costs partially offset operating-margin pressure.

favorable.assumptions: Better cost recovery and complex-generics mix, revenue 1700 cr and EBIT margin 17%, alongside modest financing benefit. No named approval or exclusivity gain is assumed.

scenario_interpretation: Uncalibrated operating sensitivities. No probabilities, confidence interval, or claim these exhaust possible outcomes.
unknowns: Gagillapur October 2026 inspection EIR remained awaited in the latest checked earnings deck. Management confidence is not regulatory clearance.
Timing and magnitude of customer price pass-through, freight/input prices and currency effects remain uncertain.
Peptide/CDMO EBITDA loss was 15.2 cr in Q2 versus 12.4 cr in Q1. New pipeline value and breakeven timing are not credited to December.
Warrant proceeds and higher absolute PAT do not imply matching EPS growth. The target is absolute owner PAT, not EPS.
Prior signed PDF was captured from a mirror. Exact prior owner PAT and zero NCI were separately corroborated in the original exchange integrated filing.
scope_of_review: Quarterly forecasting supplement. No complete governance, valuation, management-quality, liquidity or portfolio suitability review. No new investment verdict.

issuer_claims.claim: Management expects input/logistics pressures to persist and customer cost recovery to lag. It reports 828 cr net cash after warrant proceeds.
Q2 peptide/CDMO EBITDA loss 15.2 cr. Gagillapur October 2026 EIR awaited.
